name: 55401 · Minneapolis, MN
findings: ZIP 55401 (Minneapolis) has 171 nonprofit organizations. 83 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 64 organizations.
Research and think tank organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55401 (Minneapolis) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 55401 (Minneapolis) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 64 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
